description: RESEARCH CORPUS COVERAGE METRICS, NOT TOTAL RUSSIAN MARKET SIZE, SALES OR MARKET SHARE
caveat: The 2024 and 2025 UDS tender dates are submission DEADLINES, not publication dates; inferred manufacturer quantities and MW ratings prohibited. The 2025 6+10 kV item is one notice with two voltage models; its scalar equipment_voltage_kv intentionally null, both values in equipment_voltage_kv_set. Most older records do not normalize voltage even if described in text. NMC cannot be summed as PQ sales because mixed and non-target notices coexist. The four new Rosseti procedures include two purchases of filter capacitor components with unknown nominal voltage and two projects at 220kV substations; 220kV is substation rating, not necessarily PQ voltage. 90,672,176 RUB is a sum of initial procurement prices, NOT total PQ equipment sales or 6-35kV market.
source_discovery_note: Four added 2025 Rosseti 223-FZ records are indexed source leads; none of their original protocols has been read or primary contract prices confirmed.
technical_family_note: СТК/SVC (thyristor controlled) distinct from СТАТКОМ/STATCOM (voltage-source converter), confirmed by Russian FACTS standard СТО 56947007-29.240.019-2009.
